{{Top|leg}}
A '''trichambered repulsorlift thrust package''' were the main propulsion system used aboard [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian's]] [[Luxury-class sail barge|''Luxury''-class sail barge]]. The package allowed the craft to reach a top speed of one hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
